title: (RHBA-2021:3720) Update to Red Hat Integration Camel K 1.4 GA image
portal_summary: An update for the Red Hat Integration 1.4 release of the 'Camel K' operator image, to address an incompatibility with Red Hat Serverless 1.17.
portal_synopsis: Update to Red Hat Integration Camel K 1.4 GA image
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|4.6|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|4.7|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description: Red Hat Serverless 1.17 is based on Knative 0.23 which removes the Subscription messaging.knative.dev/v1beta1 API. Customers using the Camel-K 1.4 operator will run into problems when upgrading to Serverless 1.17.
